title: Easy flat + mobility
coachNotes: DECIDING GATE. Thursday came back clean on the lateral knee, so Saturday is provisionally on at 155 / 1000m D+ and this morning is what confirms it. 48h post-descent is the window in which a developing band problem actually announces itself, so the Thursday result does not carry the decision on its own. Clean this morning and Saturday goes as written. Any lateral tightness or that specific band-over-the-condyle ache on stairs down and Saturday drops to 800m D+ and load 110, decided this evening, not on the trail. HRV RULE FOR THIS MORNING, UPDATED, this replaces the old 'under 52' line: judge the 7-day/28-day ratio, not the single reading. Thursday's raw 49 sat inside a ratio of 1.039 and meant nothing, it was the expected post-session dip after a 152-load day. Take full rest instead of this jog only if the ratio falls below 0.90, or if RHR reads 56+ against the local Alps baseline B of 53. Either way it costs nothing. THE JOG ITSELF: valley floor only, no climbing, no descent. Thirty minutes, flat, conversational, stop early if it feels like work. Saturday is the single confirmed weather window of the weekend and it carries the last real vertical before the race, so today exists only to keep the legs open.
